text:
michael: Follow-up from RFC spike: propose a bounded reclaim policy for edge streams to avoid long-tail idle contexts consuming KV memory. Idea: three-stage lifecycle: active -> grace -> reclaim. Grace lets short pauses continue; reclaim frees resources and returns a clear trailer.

tara: Agreed. Need to standardize client-visible signal. Suggest final chunk/trailer payload like: {"reclaim-id":"r-202603","reason":"idle","stage":"reclaim","partial":"true","sideeffect_safe":"false","retry_hint_ms":"1200"}. Trailer must be small and machine-readable.

hugo: Important infra change: we must add per-stream lightweight footprint: kv_mb_estimate, buffered_bytes, last_activity_ms. Admission sums kv_mb_estimate across the pool to decide reclaim. Update these counters on writes only.

nina: Operational modes: soft_reclaim (emit trailer, release resources) vs hard_reclaim (abort conn). Default: soft for hosted PLG, hard available for constrained Dedicated. Add warmup window to avoid reclaiming immediately.

michael: Billing: emit event tagged with reclaim-id and tokens_consumed so finance can mark it partial. If client retries and completes, that attempt is billed normally. Ensure logs link reclaim-id -> trace-id.

ops-bot: RFC PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/312. CI: reclaim-path test failing. :rotating_light:

tara: Action items: (1) runtime: add per-stream footprint gauge (hugo), (2) runtime: trailer emitter + reclaim state machine (michael), (3) billing: partial markers + trace link (hugo + finance), (4) devex: SDK guidance for detecting `reclaim-id` and `sideeffect_safe` (nina).

hugo: Observability: emit counters ingress.stream.reclaim.count{reason,mode,pool} and histogram ingress.stream.time_since_last_chunk_ms at reclaim. Also expose per-tenant reclaim rates.

nina: UX: support opt-in header `x-redwood-preserve-stream: duration_ms` for critical long-lived streams, default off for PLG. Document as admin-only for Dedicated.

michael: Let's ship spike behind feature-flag and run canary on a single Dedicated pool with dashboards and kill-switch. Prioritize safe defaults: prefer soft_reclaim and clear trailers.

ops-bot: TODOs created: INF-9001 (per-stream footprint), INF-9002 (reclaim trailer schema), INF-9003 (billing partial markers).
